acquisition method: Mass spectra were acquired in a data-dependent manner, with an automatic switch between MS and MS/MS using a top-15 method.
alkylation reagent: Briefly, cysteine residues were blocked with 50 mM iodoacetamide buffer
alkylation concentration: Briefly, cysteine residues were blocked with 50 mM iodoacetamide buffer
cleavage agent: proteins were digested with trypsin (1:40 trypsin/protein; Promega)
collision energy: HCD fragmentation was performed at 30 of normalized collision energy
fragmentation method: HCD fragmentation was performed at 30 of normalized collision energy
instrument: coupled via a nanoelectrospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany) to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: coupled via a nanoelectrospray ion source (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany) to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer
labeling: using TMT reagents (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and following the manufacturer’s instructions.
mass analyzer: MS/MS spectra were analyzed at 60,000-pixel resolution in the Orbitrap.
precursor tolerance: Precursor mass tolerance was set at 800 parts per million (ppm)
fragment tolerance: fragment mass tolerance was set at 0.03 Da
ptm: Cys carbamidomethylation (57.021464 Da) fixed; TMT labeling at the N-terminal end fixed; Lys (229.162932 Da) dynamic; Met oxidation (15.994915) dynamic
using Cys carbamidomethylation (57.021464 Da) and TMT labeling at the N-terminal end as fixed modifications and Lys (229.162932 Da) and Met oxidation (15.994915) as dynamic modifications.
